youtube.baslik: Why does the ear make a third sound when given two tones? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In DPOAE testing, two tones, f1 and f2, are played into the ear canal at once. Because a healthy cochlea is nonlinear, it creates sounds at new frequencies; in humans the largest is at 2f1-f2. For example, if f2 is 2000 Hz, the product is sought near 1280 Hz; this nonlinearity depends on outer hair cells.
